notes.title: QoL Update 2
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44626676/30a4862c5b920aef0db930cff55ee99595fc179c.gif[/img]

Super small update.  There might be a bigger update coming.

What changed:
Added an undo button to the end game menu when you lose.
Beating a level now has sparkly particles.

notes.title: QoL Update 1
notes.content:
Hey everyone, I hope you and the penguins are having fun!

This is the first of a few Quality of Life updates due to player feedback.  Thanks for letting me know how to make the game better.  Keep it coming!

This update adds the ability to rotate the map.  You can click the Eye icon in the upper left, or press spacebar.

When playing with creative mode, it no longer tricks you into deleting your map.

More to come.

Thanks!
LimeBlossom
